scoring_justification: Recompute Pearson R² and MAE against hidden experimental pKa values from the paper's Table 5; full recompute of agreement metrics from agent's raw CSV without trusting self-reported numbers.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden experimental pKa values for 12 halogenated pyridines (molecule order per paper Scheme 2) used as gold reference.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 5, 'Experimental' column: values taken from Ref. [34] with exception of compound 1 taken from Ref. [35].
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the published paper's Table 5 under the 'Experimental' heading.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact experimental reference values the paper used to compute its reported correlations; fabricating them would break the task semantics.

outputs.description: Computed absolute pKa values for 12 halogenated pyridine derivatives at HF/6-31G(d) and B3LYP/6-31G(d) levels. The checker will recompute Pearson R² and mean absolute error (MAE) against hidden experimental pKa values for each method.

output_contract.notes: The agent may use any consistent ΔG_s(H⁺) value within the stated range; the checker tolerates different choices. The experimental pKa values are used only as hidden gold for metric recomputation.

steps.description: Score HF pKa values against experimental pKa
